items.title: Angola aims for faster oil and gas concessions as part of new regulatory revamp
items.summary: Angola intends to implement faster exploration concessions from next year as part of a new long-term hydrocarbon strategy that aims to attract investment and stimulate oil and gas production, a senior government official said on the sidelines of an energy conference in Cape Town.
